manual.chassis_length: 9 bits share the word at offset 0 with the 7-bit TLV type; the probe pins the footprint (layer bytes 0-1) but logical bit 9 is clamped by scapy's 9-bit field, so the mask/shift view is hand-declared and crosscheck-verified
manual.chassis_subtype: the probe pins the footprint at layer byte 2, but the chassis id encoding is subtype-dependent (scapy MultipleTypeField: MAC address at 4, network address at 5); the subtype=4 bit probe re-encodes the chassis id and changes derived bytes
